text:
ana: Heads up — seeing duplicated/overlapping SSE chunks on reconnect when auth refresh happens mid-stream. Repro in python SDK with short client timeouts.

sam: Any chance this is Last-Event-ID resume related or duplicate delivery from proxy?

ana: resume. flow is: client times out on a long response, auth refresh kicks in, client reconnects with Last-Event-ID header, server resumes but sends a chunk that contains the tail of the previous event plus the next event, python parser applies both and we get duplicated text in the final message.

julian: can you paste the raw chunk fragments you saw? are they full SSE frames or partial lines?

ana: paste from logs:
```
chunk#1: "id: 123\nevent: message\ndata: Hello world pa"
chunk#2: "rt 2\n\n"
chunk#3 (after reconnect): "id: 123\nevent: message\ndata:  Hello world part 2\n\nid: 124\nevent: message\ndata: Next message\n\n"
```

sam: oh — chunk#3 repeats id 123 and then emits id 124. If the reconnect code appends chunk#3 to buffered partial 'part 2' it will form a duplicate. JS SDK dedupes by event id on resume — does python?

ana: python currently doesn't dedupe on resume, it assumes chunk boundaries won't overlap on resume.

lena: this smells like the parser's state machine: it keeps a partial_line buffer and concatenates on each read. On resume we don't check last_seen_id before re-appending that buffer. Proposed fix: when reconnecting with Last-Event-ID=X, drop any partial buffer and ignore incoming frames with id <= X.

julian: also need to consider auth-retry races: token refresh can trigger duplicate connect attempts (one times out, refresh starts, another reconnect happens). That causes two concurrent connections where both deliver overlapping events. We should gate reconnects so only one resume attempt is active per client connection.

ana: workaround for now: set reconnect_backoff to 500ms and pause auth-refresh-triggered reconnect until previous attempt finishes. Not ideal but reduces dup rate.

devex-bot: ci: build #2026.03.15-rc3 failed — tests/sse_resume_dup.py flaky. https://ci.redwood.example/2026/2026.03.15-rc3

lena: grabbing this. I'll add unit tests for: (1) resume where server resends partial chunk, (2) duplicate connect attempts, (3) Last-Event-ID filtering. Also add an integration test that simulates token refresh delay and reconnect overlap.

sam: can we add a small patch that 1) drops partial buffer on resume and 2) dedup by id before emitting? small change should fix majority of cases.

lena: yes, will send PR. Also will add comment in python SDK README about the temporary config knob and recommend JS parity for now.

julian: after PR, let's run a stress harness that injects out-of-order chunks, delay reconnects, and random 4xx/5xx from auth service.

ana: thanks — ping me when you want the logs. :pray: 

sam: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
